subject: Data description and representation
notes: Stem: `OK  §8.5.4` "A zero-length item is a data item or a literal whose minimum length is zero and whose length at runtime is zero." The compiler holds the stem's description half as ONE recurrence (DataItem.MinimumLengthIsZero) and the runtime half as the emitted current-length test; consumers read it (MoveClassifier.ZeroLengthItemRoute / MoveEmitter for §14.9.25.4 GR1, CobolClass for §8.8.4.4.4 GR1, STRING/UNSTRING/INSPECT runtime length). Item 1 (`OK §8.5.4 1)` checked via stem): the recurrence answers yes when every non-redefining child has MinimumOccurrences 0 (ODO integer-1). Probe p1 (pinned cobol.exe, --std 2023): `01 ZG. 05 ZE PIC X OCCURS 0 TO 5 DEPENDING ON N.` with N=0 -> IS ALPHABETIC false / IS NOT ALPHABETIC true (§8.8.4.4.4 GR1-2, `OK §8.8.4.4.4 1)`), MOVE ZG TO PIC X(5) = 5 spaces, STRING ZG DELIMITED SIZE "Q" -> sender ignored (`OK §14.9.43.4 3) a)`) giving QBCDE, UNSTRING ZG -> receiver unchanged (`OK §14.9.48.4 2)`), INSPECT tally 0, FUNCTION LENGTH 0; p7 MOVE ZG TO PIC XX/XX = "  /  " (GR1's substituted SPACE edited). The 'containing ONLY' discriminator is pinned by unit:ZeroLengthItemDriftTests.OrdinaryShapes_AreNotZeroLengthItems (MIXED group answers no).
